result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A shows all seven cards on screen in an even 4+3 grid with matching gutters, and every card lines up price and Sign up in the same row. B's cards are well built, with full-width buttons that are easy to tap, but its 3+3+1 layout leaves one card alone on the last row, cut off below the visible area. Both add a subtitle the request didn't ask for: A claims materials and firing are included, and B says no experience is needed. A's claim is a riskier one to invent, and A also expands day names such as 'Tuesdays' where B copies the stated values exactly. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B shows all seven cards in an even 4+3 grid at the screenshot width. Each card has a clear order, and the price and Sign up button line up across every card. In A, the seventh card (Sculpture Studio) is cut off below the fold, sits alone in its row and can't be checked. Both pages add some taglines nobody asked for. B's claim that 'all materials and firing included' is a factual promise the studio never made, and it also rewrites the schedules slightly (for example, 'Tue' becomes 'Tuesdays'). The page source wasn't provided, so the scores for items 3 and 4 come from the layouts alone.
